diagnosis: The customer attempted to enable Private Networking in the ap-south region, which according to the knowledge base is not a supported region for this feature. Additionally, Private Networking is a premium‑only feature and the account's current plan/entitlement does not include it, so the request is being queued rather than failing.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Private Networking is currently only available in the us-east, us-west, and eu-west regions. It is not yet supported in ap-south, so attempts to enable it in that region will not take effect and will remain queued. If you need this capability sooner, you may consider using one of the supported regions or upgrading to a plan that includes the Private Networking entitlement. We’ll keep you posted on any future regional availability updates.
